name: ArtifactsBench
description: A benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models on interactive visual artifacts generation. Contains 1,825 diverse tasks spanning nine domains (Game Development, SVG Generation, Web Applications, Simulations, Data Science, Management Systems, Multimedia Editing, Quick Tools, Others) with stratified difficulty levels (Easy/Medium/Hard). Tasks assess visual fidelity, interactive correctness, and code quality through multimodal evaluation.
creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
rai:dataCollection: Multi-stage pipeline combining expert sourcing with LLM generation and refinement. Candidates aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters applied to drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics (state changes, animations, responsiveness).
rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Flagged items are re-authored or discarded. Experts rewrite for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items. Two-stage de-duplication filtering using MinHash + semantic similarity and screenshot perceptual hashing. Prompt rewriting by experts and LLMs for clarity/completeness/executability with human verification. Difficulty assigned post hoc by aggregated performance of 30+ models to enforce 30%/40%/30% split (realized as 559/611/655). Sub-categories tagged by lightweight classifier with human spot-checks.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. LLM-drafted and human-refined for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references. The 10 items grouped into five vision-oriented and five code-oriented dimensions. Checklists generated by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed achieves Cohen's κ≥0.8 among annotators for calibration. Human validation study conducted on 280 queries with 6 models, judged by multiple front-end engineers following double-blind protocol. Agreement measured by Pair ACC. Pairwise agreement up to 90.95% with human experts achieved.
rai:annotatorDemographics: Multiple front-end engineers with extensive development experience for human validation study
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Hunyuan-Turbos for checklist generation, Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B as MLLM-as-Judge referees for automated scoring
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Privacy dimension included in quality filtering to ensure queries avoid requesting or involving sensitive personal information such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details
rai:dataLimitations: Current methodology evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing screenshots at fixed intervals, which may not fully capture fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. Focus on evaluating final artifact quality in single turn from given prompt; does not assess LLM capability to function as autonomous agent for iterative refinement, debugging, or multi-step development. Tasks solved only by brittle hacks (e.g., hard-coded coordinates that break under minor viewport changes) are revised or removed.
rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation for evaluating LLM capabilities in generating interactive visual artifacts. Benchmark designed to assess visual fidelity, interactive correctness, and code quality across diverse domains. Provides diagnostic insights on model strengths and failure modes, particularly on intensive-interactive tasks and complex Management System scenarios.
